mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.artifact_commit (commit_id, repo_id, commit_status, commit_source, created_by, comment, meta) VALUES ( #{commitId}, #{repoId}, #{commitStatus}, #{commitSource}, #{createdBy}, #{comment}, #{meta, typeHandler=com.fwdrobo.sirius.handler.JsonbTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT commit_id, repo_id, commit_status, commit_source, created_by, published_by, created_at, published_at, comment, meta FROM public.artifact_commit WHERE repo_id = #{repoId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT commit_id FROM public.artifact_commit WHERE repo_id = #{repoId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT commit_id, repo_id, commit_status, commit_source, created_by, published_by, created_at, published_at, comment, meta FROM public.artifact_commit WHERE repo_id = #{repoId} AND commit_status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT commit_id, repo_id, commit_status, commit_source, created_by, published_by, created_at, published_at, comment, meta FROM public.artifact_commit WHERE repo_id = #{repoId} AND commit_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY published_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
